ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum AAathabun aleemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.translit: Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner

ayahs.arabic: أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.translit: Ani oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu waateeAAooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me

ayahs.arabic: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚ لَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum taAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلࣰ ا وَنَهَارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmee laylan wanaharan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيٓ إِلَّا فِرَارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Falam yazidhum duAAaee illa firaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But my invitation increased them not except in flight

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wainnee kullama daAAawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jiharan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then I invited them publicly

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver

ayahs.arabic: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

ayahs.arabic: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلࣲ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anharan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers

ayahs.arabic: مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَطۡوَارًا
ayahs.translit: Waqad khalaqakum atwaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: While He has created you in stages

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allahu sabAAa samawatin tibaqan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAala alshshamsa sirajan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ نَبَاتࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: WaAllahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمۡ فِيهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Thumma yuAAeedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِسَاطࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: WaAllahu jaAAala lakumu alarda bisatan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

ayahs.arabic: لِّتَسۡلُكُواْ مِنۡهَا سُبُلࣰ ا فِجَاجࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That you may follow therein roads of passage

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawnee waittabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss

ayahs.arabic: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرࣰ ا كُبَّارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wamakaroo makran kubbaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they conspired an immense conspiracy

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدࣰّ ا وَلَا سُوَاعࣰ ا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAan wala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرࣰ اۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error

ayahs.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارࣰ ا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni Allahi ansaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
ayahs.translit: Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرࣰ ا كَفَّارࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Innaka in tatharhum yudilloo AAibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever

ayahs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا
ayahs.translit: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction
